about: Pick up playing on the PlayStation®5 exactly where you left off on the PlayStation®4 at any time by simply importing the save game from the PlayStation®4 version!
Our popular burger hero Big B is back - and this time he shows that he can not only jump, but also climb!
In "The Jumping Burger Climb", it's up to you to get Big B higher and higher up the tower on his daring journey.
What can you expect in this adventure of skill?
Endless climbing fun: jump, climb and master the heights as you work your way up from platform to platform - how far can you make it?
Customizable difficulty level: Choose the challenge that suits you and find out if you can conquer the tower on the highest difficulty level
Big B is back: Our juicy burger hero brings all his charm to make this adventure even more exciting.
High score hunt: Outdo yourself and show everyone how far you can climb!
Are you ready to go higher and higher with Big B and master the ultimate burger climbing challenge?
summary: Pick up playing on the PlayStation®5 exactly where you left off on the PlayStation®4 at any time by simply importing the save game from the PlayStation®4 version!
